summary: No catalog setting can be safely changed from these calls. The February calls contain no configuration discussion; although Venterra said on February 4 that it was not a potential customer, the later September 30 call shows renewed exploration and agreement to a future solutions workshop. That latest call was still a product and AI discovery session—not a first-property configuration meeting. Keep catalog defaults pending the decisions below.

callsUsed.title: Entrata|Venterra - Entrata Console (Overview)
callsUsed.brief: Kenneth, Christian and Jacob from Entrata, along with Andrew from Venterra Realty Management Inc., discussed Entrata's AI approach, including its unified data layer, agent-based automation (L1-L5), and the Entrata Pro platform for AI integration and analytics. Venterra expressed interest in understanding future AI trends and how Entrata's solutions could eliminate work and improve efficiency, particularly regarding governance and data integration. The call concluded with a proposed solutions workshop to collaboratively build and test agents for Venterra's specific workflows.
